Datia Assembly Bypoll: Narottam Mishra's Seat Sees Political Reshuffle

The Datia assembly constituency is preparing for a bypoll, marking a significant shift in its political landscape. For the first time in 16 years, the anticipated electoral contest between Narottam Mishra and Rajendra Bharti will not materialize. Senior BJP leaders are expected to campaign in Datia, indicating the party's focus on securing victory in the constituency.
